subject: Pen test vendor ops: access playbook, scope amendment, and final report handoff
messages:
From: lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com
To: eng@cyphersec.io, t.howard@acme-iot.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com
Date: 2027-02-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: [Action] Pen test kickoff — initial access, window, and evidence expectations

Hi Tom / Cyphersec team,

Thanks for agreeing to run the external penetration test for Acme IoT next week. To keep things tight for SOC 2 evidence, a few asks up front so we don’t have to circle back during testing: 

- Scope: external web app (app.acme-iot.com) + OAuth integration endpoints; no internal host scans unless we confirm a scoped IP list.
- Window: 2027-02-22 02:00–10:00 UTC (preferred); please confirm if you need any extra days.
- Access: we can provide a temporary bastion for SSH/RDP and an SFTP drop for large artefacts. I’ll share creds expiring after 7 days.
- Evidence: final signed report, executive summary (1 page), and a CSV of validated findings for our ticketing system.
- Deliverable deadline: final report requested by 2027-02-25 COB to feed into our SOC 2 evidence pack.

Attachments: initial scope doc (v1).

Please confirm scope as-is or propose changes today so we can approve and provision access.

Thanks,

Lauren Bishop
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com
Office: +1 415-555-0123
From: eng@cyphersec.io
To: lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com, t.howard@acme-iot.com
Cc: reporting@cyphersec.io
Date: 2027-02-18T12:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: [Action] Pen test kickoff — initial access, window, and evidence expectations

Hi Lauren / Tom,

Thanks — Cyphersec confirms the window 2027-02-22 02:00–10:00 UTC. A couple of clarifying items after reviewing your scope v1: 

1) OAuth endpoints: we need the test client_id/client_secret or a test account with elevated scopes to exercise token refresh flows.
2) API subdomain: we see api.acme-iot.com in telemetry; please confirm if that should be included.
3) TLS cert chain: if you have intermediate certs behind a CDN, can you share the cert bundle to avoid false positives?

Operational needs:
- Temporary bastion (jump host) credentials with sudo for one account (we will not create persistent users).
- SFTP write account for compressed logs and PCAPs (max 5GB).
- Point of contact during testing: Tom Howard (we’ll call on +1 617-555-0188).

We can absorb a single extra subdomain (api.acme-iot.com) without schedule changes but need confirmation today to update the statement of work and scope amendment.

Regards,
Maya Patel
Lead Engagement Manager | Cyphersec Labs
eng@cyphersec.io
From: lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com
To: eng@cyphersec.io
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com, t.howard@acme-iot.com
Date: 2027-02-18T14:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: [Action] Pen test kickoff — initial access, window, and evidence expectations

Maya — thanks for the quick review. Confirming the additions: 

- Please include api.acme-iot.com in scope (addendum attached).
- We’ll provision a test OAuth client (client_id+secret) and drop into the shared vault; I’ll DM the vault link to your reporting mailbox.
- Cert bundle: attached to this thread (intermediate-chain.pem).

Access notes:
- Temporary bastion: I’ll email one-time creds by EOD 2027-02-19. They will be time-limited and logged via our session proxy.
- SFTP: account created — credentials to follow. Drop directory: /reports/acme-pt/

Vivek — FYI, adding api subdomain increased external exposure surface; please ensure on-call knows about the window.

Thanks,
Lauren

Attachments: cyphersec-scope-amendment-v2.pdf, intermediate-chain.pem
From: eng@cyphersec.io
To: lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com
Cc: reporting@cyphersec.io, t.howard@acme-iot.com
Date: 2027-02-19T09:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: [Action] Pen test kickoff — initial access, window, and evidence expectations

Lauren,

Received the scope amendment and cert bundle — thanks. Two operational follow-ups before the test: 

1) We attempted the bastion test connection this morning and saw the jump host IP blocked by the corporate firewall. Can you confirm the allowed source IPs list we should open? We will run from these egress IPs: 34.210.112.45, 52.87.66.31.
2) For SFTP: please confirm max file-size and retention policy so we can rotate large PCAPs as needed.

If those are ok, we’ll proceed with the scheduled start. Also, please attach the redacted NDA-signed acknowledgement (we need it for our engagement file).

Finally, quick ask: if remediation steps are validated during the test window, can your team provide short, time-stamped notes in the shared ticket so we can mark findings as 'verified' prior to final report generation? That will speed up the deliverable.

Best,
Maya Patel
Lead Engagement Manager | Cyphersec Labs
From: lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com
To: eng@cyphersec.io
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, t.howard@acme-iot.com
Date: 2027-02-21T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: [Action] Pen test kickoff — initial access, window, and evidence expectations

Maya — quick operational update ahead of tomorrow: 

- Firewall: allowed egress IPs 34.210.112.45 and 52.87.66.31 are open to the jump host (confirmed at 2027-02-21T16:30Z).
- Bastion creds: uploaded to the vault and a one-time secret sent to eng@cyphersec.io (see lauren-temp-bastion-creds.txt attachment). Expiry: 2027-02-28T00:00Z.
- SFTP: 5GB max per upload; retention 14 days. Directory: /reports/acme-pt/. Please mark any encrypted artefacts with .enc so we can prioritize decryption.
- NDA: copy of the redacted signed agreement attached.

Remediation / evidence flow: Marissa (cc’d) will be the point for verification notes. If you raise a medium/high finding and we patch during the window, please paste the ticket URL into the finding comment and Marissa will reply with a verification timestamp and short validation notes. That will be included in the CSV you provide.

Deliverable reminder: final signed report + 1-page exec summary + CSV of findings by 2027-02-25 COB. If you foresee a delay, notify us immediately so we can update the SOC 2 timeline.

Thanks all — see you on the kickoff call tomorrow morning.

Lauren Bishop
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: lauren-temp-bastion-creds.txt, NDA-redacted.pdf, final-report-stub.pdf
